text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити wins against Тамамо Кросс.
Despite
her victory, the crowd still
obsesses over her
appearance rather
than her strength.

Conversely, Тамамо Кросс is noted for
her
running, even though she lost. The
difference in
treatment devastates Gold
City.

Тамамо Кросс is angered by Голд Сити's
gutless
performance and asks her why
she runs in the first
place, but Голд Сити
can't find an answer.

When she talks to me, she quietly
concedes that
nothing she does will ever
change her reputation.
But when asked if
she would stop running, she
does
nothing to affirm.

Unconvinced that she truly wants to give
up, I
decide to register her for the Osaka
Hai, with my
eyes now set on the Senior
Spring Triple Crown.
